Nina (People Ops): Heads up — Liam in eng says he moved to Spain on Jun 1 and is worried about his W-2 and withholding for 2025. Can payroll advise?
Priya K.: oh thanks for flagging. Did he update his address in the HR portal and file a change of tax status?
Liam (Eng): I updated my home address in Ripley profile on 2025-06-02. I also told my manager. I assumed US payroll would keep doing the W-2 but I got an email about year-end docs and I want to avoid double taxation. What do I need to do from my side? :thinking_face:
Ben (Payroll): Short answer: moving abroad generally changes where we withhold and whether we issue a US W-2. Long answer: depends on employment status (employee vs contractor), whether Redwood has a payroll entity in Spain or uses a local payroll partner, and tax residency/treaty rules.
Ben (Payroll): @Nina / @Priya we need to confirm: 1) was Liam set up as an employee on US payroll through ADP/RemoteCo or as a contractor? 2) exact move date (Liam said Jun 1) and whether he has right to work in Spain.
Liam (Eng): I'm an employee on US payroll (ADP) still. Move date: 2025-06-01. I have a Spanish NIE and residencia pending — should be final by end of July.
Priya K.: thanks. Ben — if we keep paying him from US payroll after he becomes tax resident of Spain, we risk local withholding obligations and payroll compliance issues. Our playbook suggests either (A) transition to contractor with local invoicing (if role allowed) or (B) run local payroll through our Spain partner and offboard from US payroll as of move date.
Ben (Payroll): Agreed. Steps I propose: 1) Pause US payroll for Liam effective 2025-06-01 (pending legal confirmation) 2) Coordinate with Global Payroll vendor to onboard him onto Spain payroll 3) Determine whether we issue a partial-year US W-2 for period paid on US payroll and provide local year-end docs for Spain. Also check tax treaty implications (US-Spain).
PayrollBot: Quick link: Redwood KB — International Moves & Payroll: https://kb.redwood.com/people-ops/international-moves (contains checklist: address update, right-to-work docs, payroll handoff, benefits continuity).
Nina (People Ops): Ben — can you open a vendor ticket and cc legal? Also ping Liam about required docs (passport, NIE, proof of address).
Ben (Payroll): Opening ticket now. Ticket #GP-4821. CCed legal. Liam, I'll DM you a checklist. Expect a confirmation from the vendor by EOD tomorrow.
Liam (Eng): thanks. One specific: will I still get a US W-2 for the Jan–May 2025 pay period? I need it for filing here.
Ben (Payroll): Yes — typical outcome: we issue a US W-2 for the period we paid him on US payroll (Jan–May) and the Spain payroll will issue its own year-end documents for the period on local payroll. We'll coordinate with tax to see if treaty relief or foreign tax credit means he can avoid double taxation. I'll confirm in the ticket.
Priya K.: FYI if we terminate US payroll mid-year we need to run a final payroll run and mark his tax residence change in ADP. Also benefits continuity — health/stock timing needs cover note.
Ben (Payroll): Noted. I'll include benefits ops. Liam, please confirm whether you want to continue Redwood health coverage or elect COBRA/Spanish provider during transition.
Liam (Eng): I'll keep Redwood coverage for now, want advice on how that works with Spanish providers.
Ben (Payroll): We'll escalate to benefits; might be temporary overlap or we may end US-based medical coverage when we switch to Spain payroll — depends on plan rules.
Nina (People Ops): Action items captured: Ben to open vendor ticket + legal, Ben to DM Liam checklist, Benefits to advise coverage options. We'll update this thread when vendor confirms. Thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
Ben (Payroll): Update — vendor replied: they can onboard Liam to Spain payroll but need signed local employment addendum, copy of NIE, and payroll start date. Asked us to confirm final payroll stop date in US. I'll post ticket updates here.
Liam (Eng): I uploaded NIE scan and signed the addendum this morning. Thanks Ben.
Ben (Payroll): Got it. Vendor confirmed Spain payroll start 2025-06-16 and US payroll stop 2025-06-15. We will issue W-2 for wages paid through 6/15. Closing loop in ticket.
Nina (People Ops): Perfect — marking this resolved here. If anything else pops up we'll reopen. :white_check_mark:
